dct_description_sm: This project brings together 15 laboratories across Canada and many collaborations to develop an integrated Earth systems science framework on diverse aspects related to thawing permafrost conditions in the Canadian Arctic. This new integrated Permafrost Systems Science approach focuses on how changing permafrost and snowfall affect tundra landscapes, water and wildlife, and the implications for Northern communities and industries who depend on these resources. (Source: www.cen.ulaval.ca/adapt/)
dct_title_s: Arctic Development and Adaptation to Permafrost in Transition (ADAPT): Bylot Island study site
